m.summary:
The bug was in `src/checkout.ts` line 6. When `reserve()` returned false, the loop did `continue`, so checkout silently skipped out-of-stock items and went on to return a total. The doc comment on line 3 says it should throw `'out of stock <sku>'` in that case.

I changed line 6 to:
```ts
if (!reserve(sku, qty)) { throw new Error(`out of stock ${sku}`); }
```

This matches the doc comment and the test in `test/checkout.test.ts` line 6, which expects `/out of stock B2/` when B2 has zero stock. The "returns the total" test is unaffected because C3 has enough stock.

I did not run `npm test`.

Side note for whoever owns `src/inventory.ts`: `reserve()` at line 6 uses `if (have <= qty) return false;`. Per its doc comment ("takes qty units if that many are left"), it should be `have < qty`. As written, it refuses to reserve the last remaining units (for example, C3 with 12 units cannot take exactly 12). I did not touch that file.
